slug: 2026-01-08 Eritrea launches ASYCUDA World digital customs system

facts.fact: Eritrea inaugurated the ASYCUDA World digital customs management system in January 2026, replacing legacy software in use since 2007, according to Shabait (Ministry of Information).
UNDP states Eritrea inaugurated ASYCUDA World, with all customs stations interconnected on an intranet for data exchange and processing, replacing a legacy system operational since 2007.
